title: Integrated Multi-Omics and Radiogenomic Analysis Identifies S100B and ITGB5 as Complementary Candidate Biomarkers of Glioblastoma Heterogeneity.
snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by marked intratumoral heterogeneity, diffuse invasion, and a profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. In this study, we applied an integrative multi-omics and radiogenomic framework to identify candidate biomarkers reflecting complementary dimensions of GBM heterogeneity.
